sentence: Many companies ______ flexible work arrangements.
sentence_zh: 許多公司______彈性工作安排。
explanation: Many companies 為複數主詞，動詞用原形 offer。

sentence: The new policy ______ employees to work remotely.
sentence_zh: 新政策______員工遠端工作。
explanation: The new policy 為單數主詞，動詞需加 -s。

sentence: All visitors must ______ their ID at the front desk.
sentence_zh: 所有訪客必須______身分證件於櫃檯。
explanation: must 後接原形動詞 show。

sentence: Please ______ the form by Friday.
sentence_zh: 請在週五前______表格。
explanation: 祈使句以原形動詞開頭：submit。

sentence: The report was completed ______ the deadline.
sentence_zh: 報告在截止日前______完成。
explanation: before 表示在某時間點之前。

sentence: Ms. Chen is responsible ______ managing the project.
sentence_zh: 陳小姐負責______管理此專案。
explanation: be responsible for 為固定搭配。

sentence: The meeting was postponed ______ unexpected circumstances.
sentence_zh: 會議因______突發狀況而延期。
tag: 連接詞 vs 介系詞
explanation: because of 後接名詞片語；unexpected circumstances 是名詞片語。

sentence: Please contact the receptionist ______ you have any questions.
sentence_zh: 若你有任何問題，請______聯絡櫃檯人員。

sentence: Sales have increased steadily ______ the past six months.
sentence_zh: 銷售在過去六個月______穩定成長。
explanation: over + 一段時間，表示整段期間內。

sentence: Applicants must have ______ experience in customer service.
sentence_zh: 應徵者必須具備______客服經驗。
explanation: experience 為名詞，前面需形容詞 previous。

sentence: The training session will begin ______ 9 a.m.
sentence_zh: 訓練課程將於上午九點______開始。

sentence: The proposal was rejected due to its ______ cost.
sentence_zh: 提案因其______成本而被否決。
explanation: cost 為名詞，需形容詞 excessive 修飾。

sentence: The system will be updated ______ the end of this month.
sentence_zh: 系統將於本月底前______更新。

sentence: Employees are encouraged to dress ______ during client meetings.
sentence_zh: 員工在客戶會議期間被鼓勵穿著______。
explanation: 修飾動詞 dress，需副詞 professionally。

sentence: The product is designed ______ improve efficiency.
sentence_zh: 此產品設計用來______提升效率。

sentence: The manager requested that the report ______ revised immediately.
sentence_zh: 主管要求報告必須立即______修訂。

sentence: No one was aware ______ the change in schedule.
sentence_zh: 沒有人察覺到______行程變更。
explanation: be aware of 為固定搭配。

sentence: The company aims to reduce costs ______ maintaining quality.
sentence_zh: 公司目標是在______維持品質的同時降低成本。

sentence: The contract will remain valid ______ both parties agree otherwise.
sentence_zh: 合約將持續有效，______雙方另有同意。
explanation: unless = if not，表示否定條件。

sentence: The seminar was attended by ______ than 200 participants.
sentence_zh: 研討會有超過 200 位參與者______出席。
explanation: than 出現，需用比較級 more。

sentence: The employee ______ the email before leaving the office.
sentence_zh: 員工在離開辦公室前______寄出那封信。
explanation: before leaving 表過去情境，動詞用過去式 sent。

sentence: The documents need to be signed ______ they are submitted.
sentence_zh: 文件在提交前需要被簽署______。

sentence: We will proceed with the plan ______ it is approved by the board.
sentence_zh: 只要計畫被董事會核准，我們就會______推進。

sentence: The marketing team is working ______ a new campaign.
sentence_zh: 行銷團隊正在致力於______一個新活動。

sentence: Please make sure the file is saved ______ you close the program.
sentence_zh: 請確保在你關閉程式______檔案已儲存。

sentence: The CEO gave a speech ______ the annual conference.
sentence_zh: 執行長在年度會議______致詞。
explanation: at 用於特定活動/地點（conference）。

sentence: The software is compatible ______ most devices.
sentence_zh: 此軟體與大多數裝置______相容。

sentence: The shipment arrived ______ schedule.
sentence_zh: 貨運按______到達。

sentence: The invoice must be paid ______ 30 days.
sentence_zh: 發票必須在 30 天內______支付。

sentence: Our team will discuss the issue ______ tomorrow's meeting.
sentence_zh: 我們將在明天的會議______討論此議題。

sentence: The receptionist asked me ______ my name and phone number.
sentence_zh: 接待員請我______姓名與電話。

sentence: The company will hire additional staff ______ demand increases.
sentence_zh: 公司將在需求上升時______增聘人員。

sentence: The printer is out of paper; please ______ it.
sentence_zh: 印表機沒紙了，請______它。

sentence: The product was shipped ______ express delivery.
sentence_zh: 產品以快遞方式______寄出。
explanation: by + 方法/手段（by express delivery）。

sentence: The manager is looking forward to ______ from you soon.
sentence_zh: 主管期待很快能______你的回覆。
explanation: look forward to 後接 V-ing。

sentence: The new employee quickly became familiar ______ the procedures.
sentence_zh: 新員工很快熟悉______流程。

sentence: The budget was approved, ______ the project can start next week.
sentence_zh: 預算已核准，______專案可於下週開始。

sentence: The office will be closed ______ national holidays.
sentence_zh: 辦公室在國定假日______休息。

sentence: Employees should submit their requests ______ writing.
sentence_zh: 員工應以書面______提出申請。

sentence: The presentation was ______ informative than expected.
sentence_zh: 簡報比預期更______有資訊量。

sentence: The company has ______ a new branch in Singapore.
sentence_zh: 公司已在新加坡______一間新分公司。

sentence: The survey results will be available ______ Monday.
sentence_zh: 調查結果將於週一______可取得。

sentence: Customers can receive a refund ______ they provide a receipt.
sentence_zh: 顧客可在______提供收據時辦理退款。

sentence: The meeting agenda was sent ______ all participants.
sentence_zh: 會議議程已寄給______所有與會者。

sentence: Please ensure that all data ______ backed up regularly.
sentence_zh: 請確保所有資料都______定期備份。
explanation: data 在商用寫作常作集合概念使用，搭配 is。

sentence: The technician will inspect the equipment ______ it is installed.
sentence_zh: 技術員會在設備安裝______進行檢查。

sentence: The company’s goal is to increase revenue ______ 10%.
sentence_zh: 公司目標是將營收提高______10%。

sentence: The new software is easier to use ______ the previous version.
sentence_zh: 新軟體比舊版更容易使用______。

sentence: The receptionist answered the phone ______.
sentence_zh: 接待員______接起電話。
explanation: 修飾動詞 answered，需副詞 politely。

sentence: The documents were filed ______ alphabetical order.
sentence_zh: 文件已按字母順序______歸檔。
explanation: in alphabetical order 為固定搭配。

sentence: The client requested a ______ copy of the contract.
sentence_zh: 客戶要求合約的______副本。
explanation: printed 作形容詞修飾 copy。

sentence: The conference room is available ______ 2 p.m. to 4 p.m.
sentence_zh: 會議室在下午兩點到四點______可使用。

sentence: The manager spoke ______ the importance of customer satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 主管談到客戶滿意度的重要性______。

sentence: We appreciate your ______ to this matter.
sentence_zh: 我們感謝你對此事的______。

sentence: The shipment was delayed ______ heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 貨運因大雨______延誤。
explanation: due to 後接名詞片語。

sentence: Employees are not allowed to use personal phones ______ work hours.
sentence_zh: 員工在上班時間______使用私人手機。

sentence: The company will conduct interviews ______ week.
sentence_zh: 公司將在下週______進行面試。
explanation: next week 為固定時間片語。

sentence: The new product is expected to ______ well in the market.
sentence_zh: 新產品預期在市場上會______良好。

sentence: The accountant will review the statements ______ they are finalized.
sentence_zh: 會計師會在報表定案______審核。

sentence: The HR department is ______ charge of recruitment.
sentence_zh: 人資部門負責招募，並且______主管此工作。
explanation: in charge of 為固定搭配。

sentence: The package was delivered ______ my neighbor by mistake.
sentence_zh: 包裹誤送______我的鄰居。

sentence: The staff meeting will be held ______ the third floor.
sentence_zh: 員工會議將在三樓______舉行。

sentence: The company is known ______ its innovative culture.
sentence_zh: 這家公司以創新文化而______聞名。

sentence: Please keep your receipt ______ you need to return the item.
sentence_zh: 請保留收據，以防你______需要退貨。
explanation: in case 表示「以防萬一」。

sentence: The training materials were distributed ______ all attendees.
sentence_zh: 訓練教材已分發______所有出席者。

sentence: The company plans to expand ______ Asia next year.
sentence_zh: 公司計畫明年擴張到______亞洲。

sentence: The supervisor insisted that everyone ______ on time.
sentence_zh: 主管堅持每個人都要______準時。
explanation: insist that 後常用原形動詞 arrive。

sentence: The new employee is ______ capable of handling the task.
sentence_zh: 新員工______有能力處理此任務。

sentence: The memo was written ______ clear language.
sentence_zh: 備忘錄以______清楚的語言撰寫。

sentence: The sales figures are ______ higher than last quarter.
sentence_zh: 銷售數字______比上季更高。
explanation: 修飾比較級 higher，需副詞 significantly。

sentence: The report includes data ______ customer feedback.
sentence_zh: 報告包含______客戶回饋的資料。
explanation: data from... 表示資料來源。

sentence: The office moved to a new location ______ May.
sentence_zh: 辦公室在五月______搬到新地點。

sentence: The manager was pleased ______ the team's performance.
sentence_zh: 主管對團隊表現感到______滿意。

sentence: The printer needs to be repaired, ______ it keeps jamming.
sentence_zh: 印表機需要維修，______它一直卡紙。

sentence: The presentation was postponed ______ the speaker was ill.
sentence_zh: 簡報延期，______講者生病了。

sentence: The customer asked ______ a discount on bulk orders.
sentence_zh: 客戶詢問是否能______大量訂購折扣。

sentence: All employees must ______ the safety rules.
sentence_zh: 所有員工必須______安全規範。

sentence: The company will announce the results ______ Friday afternoon.
sentence_zh: 公司將在週五下午______公布結果。

sentence: The brochure provides information ______ our services.
sentence_zh: 宣傳冊提供______我們服務的資訊。

sentence: The manager spoke ______ enough for everyone to hear.
sentence_zh: 主管講得夠______讓大家聽見。

sentence: The software update will fix several ______ issues.
sentence_zh: 軟體更新將修復數個______問題。
explanation: issues 為名詞，需形容詞 technical 修飾。

sentence: The staff were instructed to arrive ______ than usual.
sentence_zh: 員工被指示比平常更______到達。

sentence: Please send the completed document ______ email.
sentence_zh: 請以電子郵件方式______寄送已完成文件。

sentence: The manager will review your request and respond ______ possible.
sentence_zh: 主管會審核你的申請並盡快______回覆。
explanation: as soon as possible = 盡快。

sentence: The company is committed to ______ waste.
sentence_zh: 公司致力於______減少浪費。

sentence: The contract was signed ______ both parties.
sentence_zh: 合約由雙方______簽署。
explanation: 被動句用 by 表示執行者。

sentence: The new schedule will take effect ______ January 1.
sentence_zh: 新時程將於 1 月 1 日______生效。

sentence: We apologize ______ any inconvenience caused.
sentence_zh: 對於造成的不便，我們______致歉。

sentence: The customer was dissatisfied ______ the service.
sentence_zh: 客戶對服務感到______不滿。

sentence: The survey was conducted ______ determine customer needs.
sentence_zh: 調查是為了______了解客戶需求而進行。

sentence: The manager asked me to ______ the meeting minutes.
sentence_zh: 主管要我______會議紀錄。

sentence: The office supplies were ordered ______ the inventory was low.
sentence_zh: 辦公用品被訂購，______庫存不足。

sentence: Employees should log out of the system ______ leaving.
sentence_zh: 員工在離開前應先______登出系統。

sentence: The company offers training programs ______ improve skills.
sentence_zh: 公司提供訓練課程以______提升技能。

sentence: The manager will be available ______ 3 p.m.
sentence_zh: 主管在下午三點______有空。

sentence: The new policy applies ______ all departments.
sentence_zh: 新政策適用______所有部門。

sentence: The company has decided to ______ the launch date.
sentence_zh: 公司已決定______上市日期。

sentence: The documents are stored ______ a secure server.
sentence_zh: 文件存放在______安全的伺服器上。
explanation: 商用常見說法：on a server。

sentence: Please review the instructions carefully ______ starting.
sentence_zh: 開始之前請仔細______檢閱指示。

sentence: The company’s headquarters is located ______ downtown Taipei.
sentence_zh: 公司總部位於台北市中心______。
